text:
maria: Starting bring-up for sparrow-13b (HF: sparrow/13b). Goal: quantize to int8, run ctx sweep (2k/4k/8k), batching profiles for 1–8 concurrent requests. Need prioritization and quick smoke today.
aj: +1. Will queue on A10G pool. Any preferred quant config? dynamic/static/awq?
chen: AWQ for int8 has looked best for similar arch. But run both awq and gptq-lite to compare.
samira: I'll own the smoke runs. Can we lock the prompt set? Need a small eval set (200 prompts) + 20 regression prompts.
maria: Use existing "openai-qc-200" set and add 20 regression prompts flagged in last regression run. I'll paste IDs.
maria: regression IDs: reg-42,reg-57,reg-88,reg-101,reg-145 (will attach full list in GH issue). @samira can you add?
samira: adding now. Scheduling initial smoke: today 18:30 PT. ETA ~45m.
perf-bot: scheduled: sparrow-13b int8-awq smoke on a10g-1. run_id=rb-2164327890-01
perf-bot: smoke results (summary): awq/int8 — throughput 92 tok/s (single stream), p50 28ms, p95 170ms, mem 11.4GB. gptq-lite — throughput 100 tok/s, p95 190ms, mem 10.8GB.
aj: hmm gptq-lite slightly faster but p95 worse. Need tail analysis: are spikes during kv-cache flush on longer ctx?
chen: also capture warm-up behavior: cold vs warmed cache. Add warmup=10 prompts.
samira: did a quick QA on reg prompts — some hallucinations on reg-88 and reg-145 (answers truncated mid-sentence). snippet:
samira: ```reg-88 prompt: "Summarize latest policy X" model out (int8-awq): "In summary, the policy focuses on reducing..." <cuts off>```
maria: that's concerning. Can you run the same prompt on fp16 baseline and gptq-lite?
samira: on it.
perf-bot: additional traces: p95 spikes coincide with context >2048 and batch_size>=4. Suggest default inference profile: max_batch=2 for ctx>4096.
aj: proposed priority: 1) resolve truncation on regressions, 2) determine preferred quant method (quality vs perf tradeoff), 3) finalize default batching/coldstart warmup; can we ship as experimental with fallback to fp16?
maria: agree. Triage steps: - collect full smoke logs + outputs (samira) - run per-quant quality eval (chen) - run ctx/batch sweep with warmup variations (aj) - create canary route with fp16 fallback (infra) - decide on release tag (green/yellow/red)
maria: I'll open GH issue and assign. If we see quality regression >2% on metric X -> block rollout.
samira: uploaded logs and sample outputs to GDrive: https://drive.redwood.ai/sparrow/smoke-2164327890
chen: I'll run automated eval with ROC-AUC/QA-F1 and compare to fp16 baseline. Expect results by EOD tomorrow.
aj: infra note: canary route requires model-variant naming: sparrow-13b:int8-awq and sparrow-13b:fp16. Will provision.
maria: thanks. If anyone finds a quick config that eliminates truncation (e.g., smaller kv-cache chunking), ping here.
samira: found quick workaround: lowering max_tokens to 256 avoids truncation but we need full-length. Not acceptable.
maria: OK locking actions. Will follow up after chen's quality pass. :thumbsup:
